EN:
I did some research on the
decorations{{TAG:0003:0015:}} used for {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Obon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cucumber horse {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is made by
sticking broken chopsticks into it.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}It represents how we'd love for a
horse to bring our ancestors to us
as quickly as possible!
Horses are fast, so the thought is
this horse will bring them to us
right away!
ES:
He buscado algo de información
sobre los adornos del Obon{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Para el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}caballo de pepino{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, por
ejemplo, se usan palillos a modo
de patas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Puede que no lo sepas, pero el
caballito es una metáfora.
Representa una idea muy sencilla...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Cuando echamos en falta a nuestros
antepasados, nada nos gustaría más
que volver a verlos cuanto antes.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Y qué mejor forma de traerlos de
vuelta que un caballo... ¡No me
dirás que no es un animal veloz!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je me suis renseignée sur la
signification de la décoration
typique d'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}O-Bon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cheval concombre {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}se fabrique en
enfonçant des morceaux de
baguettes à la place des pattes.
Il représente la possibilité pour nos
ancêtres de nous rejoindre, à dos de
cheval.
Grâce à leur rapidité, les chevaux
pourraient ramener les ancêtres sur
terre en un clin d'œil !
IT:
Ho fatto una ricerchina sulle
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}decorazioni usate per l'Obon{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Il {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cetriolo dell'Obon {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}rappresenta
un cavallo.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Il cetriolo costituisce il corpo
e le gambe si creano utilizzando
delle bacchette spezzate.
Visto che vorremmo tanto
rivedere i nostri antenati...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}... ci affidiamo simbolicamente
a un cavallo affinché ce li riporti
il più velocemente possibile!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich habe mich ein bisschen über die
Dekorationen schlau gemacht, die
wir zu {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Obon {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}traditionell verwenden.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Das {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Gurkenpferd {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}ist dazu da,
unsere Vorfahren so schnell
wie möglich zu uns zu bringen.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dank ihrer Schnelligkeit sind Pferde
bestens für diese Aufgabe geeignet!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Obon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}} için kullanılan
süsleri biraz
araştırdım.{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Salatalık atı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
kırık yemek çubuklarını
salatalığa saplayarak yapılıyor.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Atalarımızı
mümkün olduğunca çabuk bize getirsin
diye atı
simgeliyor! Atlar hızlıdır; yani
onları hemen bize ulaştırsın diye düşünülüyor!

EN:
I did some research on the
decorations{{TAG:0003:0015:}} used for {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Obon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}eggplant cow {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is made by

ES:

queridos, queremos que tarden
mucho en irse de nuestro lado.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Y qué mejor forma de impedir que
se marchen... ¡Pocos animales hay
más parsimoniosos que la vaca!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je me suis renseignée sur la
décoration typique d'{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}O-Bon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pour fabriquer un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cheval

transport idéal !
IT:

DE:

TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Obon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}} için kullanılan
süsleri biraz
araştırdım.{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Patlıcan ineği{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},

patlıcana saplayarak yapılıyor.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Atalarımız

İnekler yavaştır; yani onları
